The Descope WordPress plugin before 1.2.0 does not validate the authentication token it receives before creating a WordPress session, accepting any non-empty token, so an unauthenticated attacker can obtain a session for any existing account, including an administrator, by supplying that account's email address.

The Auth Armor  WordPress plugin through 1.0.3 does not require authentication on several handlers available to logged-out users, which leak the site's stored API credentials and allow an unauthenticated attacker to reset an administrator's enrollment and take over that administrator account.

The JDBC based JAAS login module accepts a login without a password for accounts whose stored password is NULL. A remote attacker who knows the user name of such an account can authenticate as that user and obtain its roles. ssvc_poc_or_active.description: Rowy through 3.0.0 contains an incorrect permission assignment vulnerability in default Firebase Storage rules that grants any user holding a role read and write access to the entire bucket. Authenticated users restricted to a single table or read-only access can use the Firebase SDK directly to list, download, overwrite, and delete any stored files.

SeaweedFS before 4.42 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the VolumeServer.FetchAndWriteNeedle gRPC method that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass the incomplete CVE-2026-73080 fix. Attackers can supply crafted replicas[].url entries or an azure_endpoint to make the volume server send requests with controlled tokens and bodies to internal services and metadata addresses

RedAmon 4.0.0 before 7.8.0 contains a missing object-level authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to control other tenants' agent sessions by supplying arbitrary session ids. Attackers can call /api/agent/sessions, interact and kill routes to list, kill, or send commands into other users' meterpreter and shell sessions on their compromised targets.

RedAmon before 7.8.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the kali-sandbox terminal server that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain a root shell by connecting to its WebSocket listener on port 8016. Attackers who can reach the port from co-resident containers or the host loopback can send keystrokes to an interactive /bin/bash session, executing commands as root inside the kal

GitBucket through 4.48.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to edit and merge other users' pull requests because the PATCH pulls and PUT pulls merge REST API endpoints only check read access. Attackers can close, reopen, retitle, retarget, or merge pull requests into the base branch without write permission on public repositories or as private-reposit

Dinky through 1.2.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in ClusterConfigurationController that allows authenticated users without cluster configuration permissions to list Flink cluster configurations. Attackers can query the /api/clusterConfiguration/list and listAll endpoints to retrieve full configJson deployment settings for every cluster in their tenant.

Rocboss paopao-ce through 0.6.0-alpha.3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows registered users to inject script by abusing #topic link wrapping in preparePost and parsePostTag. Attackers can publish posts or comments with a crafted topic containing a lone '<' and event handler to steal the PAOPAO_TOKEN JWT from localStorage and take over viewer accounts.

Rocboss paopao-ce through 0.6.0-alpha.3 contains a payment bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain paid attachments by reading storage URLs from the GET /v1/post endpoint. Attackers can download the paid file directly from the unauthenticated LocalOSS /oss static route, whose signed URL expired parameter is never checked.

REBUILD 4.5.0 through 4.5.4 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to recover the administrator password hash by filtering User.password through the MCP QueryRecords tool. Attackers can send LK2 prefix-match filters to the /gw/mcp/sse gateway and use the returned total count as an oracle to extract the SHA-256 hash one character at a time, t

DeepAudit 2.0.0-beta.1 through 3.8.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated users to write arbitrary files by importing projects with crafted IDs. Attackers can set absolute or ../ project IDs via /api/v1/database/import, then upload ZIPs through /api/v1/scan/upload-zip following cloned symlinks to overwrite app/main.py for remote code execution.

thirdweb Dashboard through commit 940b3745 contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows remote attackers to send users to arbitrary sites by supplying an unvalidated redirectUri parameter on the /pay/[id] payment link page. Attackers can distribute payment links with a malicious redirectUri that PayPageWidget opens via window.open after payment without noopener, enabling phishing and revers

thirdweb Dashboard through commit 940b3745 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in revalidatePathAction and revalidateCacheTagAction server actions in revalidate.ts. Unauthenticated attackers can use action identifiers exposed in the client bundle to send POST requests that purge cached pages and data, forcing repeated regeneration and degrading performance.

thirdweb Dashboard through commit 940b3745 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read non-public team metadata by requesting the team join page with any invite ID. Attackers who know a team slug can obtain the serialized Team object, exposing billing email, billing status, Stripe customer ID, verified domain and support identifiers.

EdgeChat 2.5.0 through 2.21.0 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows invited users to inject HTML through unescaped usernames in the Vditor @-mention autocomplete. Attackers can register with a username containing an img onerror payload that executes when mentioned, stealing the localStorage session token to take over victim accounts.

Bolo (bolo-solo) 1.7 through 2.6.4 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read article view passwords via the public GET /articles endpoint. Attackers can retrieve the plaintext articleViewPwd field returned by ArticleProcessor.getArticlesByPage and submit it to read password-protected article content.

GPAC before 26.02.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in m2tsdmx_update_sdt() in src/filters/dmx_m2ts.c that allows attackers to crash the MPEG-2 TS demuxer. Attackers can supply a crafted .ts file with an invalid service descriptor leaving service or provider names NULL to crash MP4Box and cause denial of service.

MicroQuickJS (mquickjs) before commit 99eed3f contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability because JS_Call() raises exceptions during frame setup without updating ctx->sp and ctx->fp. Attackers can supply JavaScript that calls a non-function value, causing build_backtrace() to walk stale frame pointers and crash the engine for denial of service.

Kroki before 0.36.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the BlockDiag family of engines that allows unauthenticated attackers to make server requests via node icon and background attributes. Attackers can send crafted diagrams to POST /blockdiag/svg or sibling endpoints to query internal services or cloud metadata and read local image files from the server.

OkHttp through 5.5.1 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in CertificatePinner that skips pin checks because Pin.matchesHostname does not normalize trailing-dot hostnames. Network attackers with a CA-trusted certificate not matching configured pins can intercept or modify TLS traffic when applications request the trailing-dot form of pinned hosts.

Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the glTF and glTF2 importers that allows attackers to read local files via crafted buffers[].uri values. Attackers can supply glTF models with '..' segments or absolute paths in buffer URIs to load files like /etc/passwd into imported mesh vertex data.

Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in MD2Importer::InternReadFile that allows attackers to read past the file buffer via an unvalidated stored frameSize header field. Attackers can supply a crafted .md2 file loaded with a non-zero keyframe selected to crash the application or leak adjacent heap memory into the imported mesh.

Course-tencent-cloud before 2.0.2 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to view other users' refund previews by supplying an order sn to /api/refund/confirm. Attackers can compute valid sn values from Sqids-encoded sequential order ids using the default key to disclose ordered items, prices, refund amounts, fees and deadlines.
